Author: kaldigo
Name: Aetherloom
Description: Inspect Glamourer designs against the current character's carried and stored equipment.
Punchline: Plan outfits from your FFXIV wardrobe.
Changelog: Rename or delete designs from their wardrobe context menu. Search by job name or abbreviation, complete tags from the existing library, or empty a gear or accessory slot. Includes new assignment pickers, a larger header mark, centred close buttons and a design-only preview. Update the Glamourer fork alongside Aetherloom.
